about: Session B1b (SIM1 fix 6): the language of our replies is the customer's, kept for the conversation. Each case is a conversation: per turn the customer's own words (typed or spoken), any button titles they tapped (never evidence of their language: the titles are ours, often product names in English), and what the model's reading said (language). `expect` is the conversation's language after that turn: ar (Lebanese Arabic, Arabic script), arabizi (Lebanese Arabic in Latin letters), en, fr. Fixed messages for ar and arabizi are Arabic; the model writes arabizi in Latin letters. From the transcripts of SIM1 (run 43696512658) and B1a's third run on main (43736730998), where a tap or a short word switched an Arabizi or Arabic customer to English or French. Judged by evals/test/conversation-language.test.ts (code, no model).
